subject: english
question: Charles Darwin lived in self-isolation because:

options.text: his city was hit by cholera
he wanted to do his research
the Great Plague was ravaging England

solution:
The correct answer is **'of his chronic ill health.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When we read the passage, we get to know the reason for** Darwin's stay in self-isolation.**
 
• It was clearly mentioned in the passage that **the reason was his chronic ill health**, and because of that, he had to live in self-isolation.
 
• In the** 5th paragraph** of the passage, Darwin clarifies the reason.
 
• It's mentioned that*** Darwin’s experience with isolation was not the result of a pandemic but his own chronic ill health. He suffered from a myriad of unexplained symptoms, including vertigo, vomiting, cramps, fatigue, anxiety, and visual disturbances.***

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**
